title: Military Discount on the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental First-Day Fee
content:
**Military courtesy terms.** The Bluegate Moving Truck Rental first-day military discount depends on the military discount on the renter's storage agreements, read from the renter's Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement records:

- a renter with an active storage agreement carrying the military discount takes the larger of that unit class's military discount rate (the class figure of the storage unit agreement) and **0.05**;
- a renter whose only such agreement is vacated takes 0.05;
- any other renter takes no military discount.

The discount is a fraction of the day-rated first-day fee; together with any other first-day discount fraction it is added up first and taken off that fee in one step, with rounding to the cent once at the end.

## Truth table (hypothetical renters)

| Storage agreements carrying the military discount | First-day military discount |
|---|---|
| An active one, on a unit class whose military discount rate is 0.10 | 0.10 — the larger of 0.10 and 0.05 |
| An active one, on a unit class whose military discount rate is 0.00 | 0.05 — the larger of 0.00 and 0.05 |
| None active; one vacated | 0.05 |
| One active and one vacated | The active one decides: the larger of its class rate and 0.05 |
| One that is neither active nor vacated (for example delinquent), and no other | None |
| None | None |
